jobs.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: No relocation assistance available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Space Systems—Missile Defense Integration offers an excellent opportunity for a Sr. Principal Agile Product Owner—Network Team Lead (26-406)
to join our team of skilled and diverse professionals. Based in Colorado Springs, CO, this role is essential to supporting the U.S. President, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at the strategic, regional, and operational levels.

This position does not provide relocation assistance and requires on-site work with no remote options.

Position Overview

The Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program is a key component of the Missile Defense System. It is a vital operational system that enables the U.S. president, the Secretary of Defense, and combatant commanders at strategic, regional, and operational levels to plan ballistic missile defense operations systematically, collectively monitor the battle, and dynamically control networked sensors and weapon systems to achieve global and regional mission goals. C2BMC supports layered missile defense capabilities that enable an optimized response to threats across all ranges and flight phases. It serves as a force multiplier by networking, integrating, and synchronizing autonomous sensor and weapon systems and operations, both globally and regionally, to improve performance. C2BMC is essential for all ground and flight tests that verify and demonstrate the current and future capabilities of missile defense systems.

In this role, the candidate will serve as a Network Team Lead. The candidate will coordinate the planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities to develop assigned technical capabilities integrated into the C2BMC Network Enterprise. The candidate will work within an agile team and plan work based on customer requirements and program contractual agreements. The candidate applies extensive expertise to solve complex problems that require regular use of ingenuity and creativity. Work is performed with minimal direction and is reviewed for desired results over a relatively long time frame. Erroneous decisions would normally fail to achieve major organizational objectives.

The Network Team Lead will serve in project leadership roles and represent the organization as the primary customer contact for significant technical matters on contracts. This position is accountable for the capability's overall engineering, technical, cost, and schedule performance. The candidate is expected to maintain clear, open communication with program and engineering management regarding status, staffing needs, and engineering projects. The candidate will drive the use of best practices within the engineering team through Agile processes, tools, and frameworks, and will review capability artifacts and development practices for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer contract requirements, and related specifications.

The candidate will provide input to standard metrics packages used for program execution status, technical improvement, and management/customer status updates. Responsibilities include managing risk mitigation activities, planning schedules, and handling change requests associated with the capabilities. The Network Team Lead will manage the execution of assigned ECP effort(s) added to the capability, coordinate and resolve deconfliction of multiple spiral and capability resources across the Agile Release Train (ART) and with other program ARTs, lead Agile and other planning activities to ensure priority and maturity are achieved, maintain the team's Hive structure and keep it up to date daily, and perform any other required tasks as directed by the program.

Essential Functions

Lead an agile network engineering team responsible for development and integration of technical capabilities into the C2BMC Network Enterprise
Coordinate planning, organization, and execution of engineering activities in accordance with program contractual agreements and customer requirements
Provide technical leadership across cost, schedule, and performance for assigned capabilities and associated ECPs
Serve as primary technical interface and customer contact for significant network-related technical matters
Apply advanced technical expertise to solve complex, multi-disciplinary problems requiring creativity and innovation
Plan and lead team Agile ceremonies and other planning activities to ensure clear priorities, maturity of work, and alignment across the Agile Release Train
Review technical artifacts, designs, and implementation approaches for compliance with engineering principles, company and program standards, customer requirements, and related specifications
Develop and provide standard metrics and status reporting for program execution, technical improvement, and management/customer updates
Manage risk and opportunity, including development and execution of risk mitigation plans, schedule planning, and change request management for assigned capabilities
Coordinate and resolve resource conflicts across multiple spirals, capabilities, and ARTs
Maintain and continuously update the team’s Hive structure and related tracking tools daily
Support planning, execution, and coordination of documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments
Support program management of strategic technical projects, problem solving, and overall business rhythm to ensure effective and efficient operations
Perform other duties as assigned in support of C2BMC program and network enterprise objectives

Basic Qualifications

Please list your current security clearance and IAT or relevant certifications on your resume, if applicable.

A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related field from an accredited university, along with 8 years of experience; or a Master’s degree in a related field with 6 years of relevant work experience; or 12 years of relevant work experience may be considered as an alternative to a degree
Applicants must have a current, active Government-Issued 8140 certification at IAT Level II or higher (such as Security+ CE, CISSP, CCNA-Security, CySA+, CND, etc.) at the time of application, which is required to start. The candidate is responsible for maintaining their 8140 certifications throughout the entire contract period
Applicants must have a current, active in-scope Government-issued Secret security clearance at the time of application, which is required to start
Active project management certification such as Project+, CAPM, or PMP (or the ability to obtain within 60 days of start)
Prior experience as an Information Technology Engineer, preferably in network or infrastructure engineering
Proven project management experience as part of large DoD systems and capabilities under development
Experience managing and reporting cost, schedule, and technical development on a large program, demonstrating the ability to coordinate planning, execution, integration, and completion of projects within an assigned area of responsibility
Experience in planning, conducting, and coordinating activities such as documentation development, technical exchange meetings with stakeholders, test events, and capability deployments
Experience managing the design, development, and implementation of complex systems
Experience with Agile methodology and/or Agile Product Owner practices; experience supporting Digital Transformation and DevOps implementation
Ability to analyze project, program, and portfolio information needs and determine the resources needed to achieve objectives
Ability to understand both the long-term (“big picture”) and short-term perspectives of situations and program needs
Demonstrated experience leading high-performance technical teams, including mentoring, coaching, and performance oversight
Strong interpersonal, presentation, communication, and facilitation skills, including the ability to effectively interface with customers, program leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders
Must be able to travel to alternate work locations as required to execute job duties

Preferred Qualifications

Prior C2BMC experience and familiarity with C2BMC NT/BC processes and procedures
Prior Team Lead and/or Product Owner experience leading Agile teams or technical capabilities
Experience developing key performance indicators (KPIs), tracking other metrics, and creating reports to support program and customer insight
Ability to quickly comprehend the functions and capabilities of new and emerging technologies and apply them with complex networked systems

What We Can Offer You

Northrop Grumman provides a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment that encourages your growth, benefiting both employees and the company. The benefits are flexible and customizable, enabling you to choose options that suit your individual and family needs. Your benefits will include the following:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Meet Benevity

Benevity is the way the world does good, providing companies (and their employees) with technology to take social action on the issues they care about. Through giving, volunteering, grantmaking, employee resource groups and micro-actions, we help most of the Fortune 100 brands build better cultures and use their power for good. We’re also one of the first B Corporations in Canada, meaning we’re as committed to purpose as we are to profits. We have people working all over the world, including Canada, Spain, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, the United States and more!

As a seasoned product marketer and leader, you possess a knack for being able to identify business and market needs, conduct research and build strategic plans, craft compelling messaging and positioning, work directly with clients, and collaborate with teams across the business to bring game-changing products to the market. You see the big picture while managing seamless execution for your portfolio.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Coaching

Mentor and develop a high-performing team of Product Marketers, providing regular coaching on core competencies such as messaging, GTM execution, and cross-functional influence.
Establish a culture of professional growth by creating tailored development plans that align individual career goals with company objectives.
Conduct regular 1:1s and performance reviews, offering actionable feedback to help team members navigate complex projects and evolve their strategic thinking.
Define and prioritize the team’s roadmap, ensuring resources are allocated effectively across product launches, sales enablement, and demand generation efforts.
Standardize PMM workflows by implementing scalable processes for launch tiering, messaging frameworks, and competitive intelligence to ensure consistent quality across the team.
Act as a strategic influencer, navigating internal stakeholder dynamics and clearing hurdles to ensure the team can execute on-time and with high impact.
Serve as the primary advocate for the PMM function at the leadership level, communicating team impact, resource needs, and strategic wins to the executive team.
Act as liaison between Product, Sales, and Marketing by aligning team output with the broader growth strategy and ensuring a unified narrative in the market.

Strategic Execution (The "Player" Role)

Own the end-to-end messaging and GTM strategy for the Benevity Enterprise Impact Platform, while guiding the team in translating this strategy into actionable plans for their respective areas.
Direct the team’s research into market trends and persona development, ensuring these insights are consistently applied to sales playbooks and GTM planning across the portfolio.
Partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Sales, CS) to align on high-level positioning, while mentoring the team on how to execute these partnerships at the project level.
Provide “Voice of Customer” insights to product management to inform product strategy, drawing from both individual research and team-wide feedback loops.
Ensure product messages proliferate throughout the buyer and client journey by collaborating with website, content, and demand generation teams.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 4+ years of direct people management or team leadership experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
A "player-coach" mindset: The ability to shift seamlessly between high-level strategic planning and hands-on execution.
Proven ability to lead through complexity, framing up strategic issues and identifying key assumptions required to gather and analyze information resulting in a GTM strategy.
Track record of building and scaling high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence at the executive level and mentor junior team members.
An analytical mind that balances a data-driven and an emotional approach to marketing.
Outstanding presentation and business writing skills.

Bonus Points

Previous experience working with CSR, social impact, or nonprofits.

Discover your purpose at work

We’re not employees, we’re Benevity-ites. From all locations, backgrounds and walks of life, who deserve more …

Innovative work. Growth opportunities. Caring co-workers. And a chance to do work that fills us with a sense of purpose.

If the idea of working on tech that helps people do good in the world lights you up ... If you want a career where you’re valued for who you are and challenged to see who you can become …

It’s time to join Benevity. We’re so excited to meet you.

Where We Work

At Benevity, we embrace a flexible hybrid approach to where we work that empowers our people in a way that supports great work, strong relationships, and personal well-being. For those located near one of our offices, while there’s no set requirement for in-office time, we do value the moments when coming together in person helps us build connection and collaboration. Whether it’s for onboarding, project work, or a chance to align and bond as a team, we trust our people to make thoughtful decisions about when showing up in person matters most.

Join a Company Where DEIB Isn’t a Buzzword

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging are part of Benevity’s DNA. You’ll see the impact of our massive investment in DEIB daily — from our well-supported employee resources groups to the exceptional diversity on our leadership and tech teams.

We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, skills and passions are what move our business and our people forward, so we're committed to creating a culture of belonging with equal opportunities for everyone to shine.

That starts with a fair and accessible hiring process. If you want to feel seen, heard and celebrated, you belong at Benevity.

Candidates with disabilities who may require accommodations throughout the hiring or assessment process are encouraged to reach out to accommodations@benevity.com.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Product Manager-Service Intelligence
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

Join an iconic brand that is redefining the pickup truck and rugged SUV marketplace. As Senior Staff Technical Product Manager
– Service Intelligence
for a confidential digital initiative, you will lead the strategy and execution of a foundational backend intelligence platform that powers critical decision‑making across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail and service ecosystem.

This role focuses on designing a backend‑driven decisioning and orchestration system that evaluates complex, interdependent operational inputs to produce reliable, scalable outcomes in real time. The platform is being built ahead of Start of Operations and will play a central role in how Scout coordinates resources, responds to events, and enables consistent execution across locations. This role operates at a cross-domain level, shaping how multiple systems, products, and operational workflows interact through centralized decision intelligence.

Initially, there is no end‑user interface or traditional UX design responsibility associated with this position; success is defined by system behavior, decision quality, and operational outcomes.

This is a deeply technical, AI‑driven and analytical role requiring strong systems thinking and comfort operating in a highly ambiguous, 0‑to‑1 environment. The successful candidate will help shape core capabilities from the ground up, owning both initial delivery and long‑term evolution of a mission‑critical intelligence platform while maintaining strict discretion around sensitive product details.

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Define and Lead Strategy

Define, evolve, and drive the product and ecosystem strategy for a confidential, intelligence‑driven core platform supporting Scout’s operations and service experience.
Define how complex operational signals, constraints, and policies are modeled into automated decision logic.
Lead early-stage platform definition ahead of Start of Operations, building foundational capabilities with no existing baseline.
Accountable for system performance across Scout’s direct‑to‑consumer retail network, ensuring decisions are reliable, explainable, and scalable.
Influence senior leadership and align platform strategy with long-term company objectives while protecting sensitive capabilities.
Identify new problem spaces and expansion opportunities for decision intelligence across additional domains and systems.

Complex Decisioning & Problem Solving

Frame and solve highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems through intelligent system design and decision frameworks.
Model operational constraints, dependencies, and priorities as structured logic, rules, or machine‑assisted decision frameworks.
Drive solutions where “missing inputs” require downstream actions to resolve constraints rather than blocking outcomes.
Navigate ambiguity inherent to 0‑to‑1 product development, making informed tradeoffs as requirements and dependencies evolve.
Evaluate tradeoffs involving accuracy, speed, scalability, and explainability, including intangible system behaviors.
Ensure system behavior is consistent, explainable, auditable, and adaptable as business rules change.

Lead Product Development

Guide product development across multiple related initiatives, teams, and domains to ensure alignment with strategic objectives.
Lead end‑to‑end product development for a highly complex, logic‑heavy platform from concept through scale.
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Data Analytics, AI/ML teams, IT, and Operations to:
Translate operational needs into system logic and technical requirements.
Define data models, decision flows, signal ingestion, and output generation.
Balance deterministic rules with AI‑assisted approaches where appropriate.
Ensure platform extensibility as new use cases and domains are added over time.
Establish best practices and frameworks for decisioning platforms adopted across related systems and teams.

AI & Intelligence Enablement

Champion the use of AI, machine reasoning, and advanced analytics to enable scalable decision‑making.
Define where AI augments human decision processes versus fully automated execution.
Ensure models and logic are transparent, testable, and continuously improvable.
Collaborate with data partners to ensure high‑quality inputs, feedback loops, and monitoring.

Stakeholder Leadership

Influence and align senior leadership, engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders on strategy, priorities, and tradeoffs.
Serve as a trusted partner to Business, Software Engineering, fellow Digital Product Customer Experience team, and Leadership teams.
Translate complex, cross‑functional needs into a shared technical and product vision without exposing sensitive strategy externally.
Lead alignment across teams with differing priorities, timelines, and constraints.
Build long‑term trust in the platform through transparency, reliability, and outcomes.

Operationalize a Pre‑Launch Platform

Build readiness for a mission‑critical platform before Start of Operations.
Define rollout strategies, guardrails, fallback behaviors, and manual override paths.
Ensure the platform supports consistent execution independent of location or context.
Define scalable operating models for how decision intelligence is embedded across systems and workflows.

Drive Technical Excellence

Drive architectural decisions across systems, data flows, and integrations, balancing long-term scalability with short-term delivery needs.
Partner with Scrum and platform teams to deliver scalable, resilient, and secure architectures.
Define best practices for real‑time decisioning systems, data latency, reliability, and observability.
Proactively identify and mitigate technical risks in logic complexity, system dependencies, and edge cases.
Ensure solutions meet enterprise security, privacy, and compliance standards.
Treat the platform as a living system, ensuring post-launch stability and continuous evolution.

Own Live Decision Intelligence

Own system behavior and decision quality once the platform is live, ensuring outcomes are accurate, explainable, and aligned with operational intent.
Monitor real-world system decisions to identify gaps, edge cases, and unintended outcomes.
Lead continuous tuning of logic, rules, thresholds, and AI-driven decision frameworks based on live data.
Define criteria for acceptable system behavior, including fallback paths, overrides, and escalation mechanisms.
Use system insights to influence product strategy and operational decision-making at a broader organizational level

Location & Travel Expectations
:

The role will be based out of a Scout Motors location in Fremont, California.
This role requires 1-3 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events. Subject to change.
Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

12+ years of product management experience with deep focus on technical platforms, complex systems, or decisioning engines.
Experience working with AI/ML technologies in a product, engineering, or business context
Proven experience leading 0‑to‑1 products in pre‑launch, startup, or transformation environments.
Track record of building logic‑heavy or intelligence‑driven systems that coordinate multiple inputs and constraints.

Technical Expertise

Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, data architectures, and real‑time processing.
Hands‑on experience working with AI/ML systems, rules engines, optimization problems, or decision frameworks.
Ability to reason deeply about tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, explainability, and scalability.
Comfort working closely with engineers and data scientists on system design.
Experience owning backend or platform products where value is delivered through system behavior and decision quality rather than user interfaces.

Skills

Demonstrated ability to define strategy in highly ambiguous environments.
Strong ability to influence senior leadership and align diverse stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical and structured problem‑solving capabilities.
Ability to define complex logic and decision flows with precision.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to simplify complexity without oversharing sensitive information.
Data‑driven mindset; comfortable working with metrics, experimentation, and system telemetry.
High tolerance for ambiguity; energized by building something new where the path is not fully defined.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
Advanced technical degree or MBA preferred.
AI-related certification required.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

Competitive insurance including:
Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

401(k) program with:
An employer match and immediate vesting

Generous Paid Time Off including:
20 days planned PTO, as accrued
40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually
Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders
Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

About this role:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Remix platform itself — its usability, scalability, and flexibility — ensuring Remix remains the most powerful and intuitive tool available to transit professionals globally.

This role sits at the center of everything Remix does. You will own the platform foundation that every module is built on, champion AI-led insights that help agencies design better service and measure real performance, and maintain the end-to-end view from planning through operations and back — ensuring data flows in ways that make each step smarter than the last. You are equally comfortable setting long-term platform direction and rolling up your sleeves to sharpen individual features and make each module best in class.

Hold the end-to-end product view: from network planning through scheduling and live operations, and back into planning via performance data — ensuring the platform is a continuous feedback loop, not a collection of disconnected tools
Identify and prioritize vertical feature investments across Remix modules, with the rigor to make each one best in class rather than broadly adequate
Partner with engineering and design to raise the bar on platform usability — reducing friction for planners, schedulers, and analysts without sacrificing the depth power users depend on
Work closely with data science and engineering to define how AI and analytics capabilities are surfaced in the product — what insights matter, when they appear, and how they drive action
Engage directly with customers to understand workflow pain points, validate priorities, and pressure-test the roadmap against real operational needs
Stay current on industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technology to ensure Remix leads rather than follows

Who you are:

You have 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platform or infrastructure-layer products used in complex enterprise workflows
You are a big-picture thinker who can articulate a multi-year platform vision while also making sharp, well-reasoned prioritization calls at the feature level
You have strong instincts for usability and product quality — you notice when something is harder than it needs to be, and you know how to fix it without breaking what works

You can quickly become technically fluent in the underlying data models and entities that power planning and scheduling systems, and you are a credible voice in technical architecture decisions alongside your engineering partners — capable of evaluating tradeoffs and advocating for platform choices that serve both current needs and long-term scalability
You have a track record of shipping high-quality features in complex, workflow-heavy enterprise environments where precision and reliability matter

Experience in transportation, transit, logistics, or resource-intensive industries is a plus; the ability to learn a technical domain quickly is essential

jobs.title: VP, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As Vice President of Product Marketing
, you’ll lead the global Product Marketing function and translate the value of our platform and multiple products into compelling narratives and go‑to‑market (GTM) strategies in order to build Via’s reputation and drive growth. This is a great opportunity to make the technology behind public transit transformation exciting and tangible for our key buying audiences. The role is both strategic and hands-on - creating excitement for Via’s product story and bringing it to life in ways that are clear, compelling, and differentiated.

You will partner with product, engineering, sales, the broader marketing team and other Via functions to understand the intricacies of the Via business, and ensure our value propositions resonate with our key audiences. The role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer, and is based in our New York headquarters.

What You'll Do:

Craft Via’s product narrative by creating clear, differentiated, and exciting messaging and positioning across our portfolio of products (Remix, Via, and Citymapper).
Partner with Product leadership to align roadmaps with customer needs and market trends while ensuring all go-to-market plans are grounded in deep product understanding.
Lead product launches that inspire customers and drive growth, including narrative development and execution across key touchpoints.
Enable GTM teams to win by delivering messaging, playbooks, and demos that improve close rates, win rates, and deal velocity.
Collaborate with Communications to create narratives and messages that influence Via’s media coverage, analyst reports, and market perception.
Collaborate on content strategy to deliver high-impact materials that engage buyers from awareness through decision.
Advance thought leadership by creating compelling content and engaging in speaking opportunities that reinforce Via’s position as the category leader.
Establish and track OKRs and KPIs for team performance, launch outcomes, and GTM effectiveness, using those insights to continuously improve.
Create replicable tools and processes to support efficiency and scale.

Who You Are:

Minimum of 13 years of Product Marketing experience in B2B or B2G environments, with a proven record of creating differentiated positioning and driving measurable business impact.
Strong strategic thinking paired with executional excellence — you can shape a vision and roll up your sleeves to make it happen.
Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Commercial, Product, and other cross functional leaders to align strategies and outcomes.
A customer-first mindset and passion for creating market-defining stories that inspire and sell.
An ability to create measurable impact - and then build systems and processes to replicate success.
Deep curiosity about how the product works, the role it plays in solving customer pain points, and what makes it truly unique.
A sense of urgency, extreme ownership, and a bias for action, staying hands-on to do whatever it takes to drive impact.
Creative, resourceful, and energized by a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Compensation and Benefits:

Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.
Salary Range: $230,000–$270,000
We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.
